posts.cooked:
I was playing against Kaargra, and by the time the battle was over, we had 44 favor to the Bloodsworn's 11.  This was mostly produced by Expatriette holding onto Mindbreaker, Seeker, and Indiscriminate all at once.  (Admittedly, getting this victory took 3 tries.  The first two had Kaargra getting ridiculous numbers of titles.  (In the first game, she got Chaos Lord, and then we got Lost in the Past, and the second game had Kaargra getting the Seeker/Mindbreaker/Indiscriminate combo)

 

This got me wondering how much favor we could aquire before the match was declared over.  So I thought I'd start a challenge in the manner of MarioFanatic's Raw Damage Challenge.  (The difference being that favor is harder to accumulate at absurd levels than damage is.)  The rules are the same: submit a screenshot and get added to the leaderboard.  Ranking is determined by how much favor the heroes accumulated, with no regard for how well the Bloodsworn did (although you must have achieved victory in order to be counted), but there is a bonus category for getting an exact multiple of the Bloodsworn's score.

posts.name: Nepycros
posts.cooked:
Perfect lockdown. Take Down happens to be an Ongoing, which Mental Divergence can infinitely recycle. Not only that, but Argent Adept helps Legacy to draw AND play Take Down out of turn. Legacy becomes immune to Melee damage, Wraith reduces all the damage the environment deals to 0, and then picks them off with some heavy damage powers. So the Villain cannot play cards or deal damage, and the environment cannot deal damage. In the Final Wasteland, with 4 Heroes, the maximum damage they could deal is 3, making 3 Mega Computers comfy.

 

It's normal to accumulate ~7-9 tokens per round using this strategy, though once the combo is set up, make sure you turn off automatic drawing, and only draw when Legacy needs to get his Take Down; if you draw your whole deck, you can't use the Library's effect to play more Environment targets for Wraith to mow down for Favor.
